Lemma
[base-uniform geodesic-uniqueness engine]

↗ lem:dc-ch3-4-2-eqon-flow-reading ↗ thm:dc-ch3-3-7

1. ch3:4.2For any $p$ there are radii $\beta ,\rho _w>0$ such that any two continuous intrinsic geodesics $\gamma _1,\gamma _2$ on open windows $\supsetneq [0,1]$, both joining $q_1\in \overline{B_\beta (p)}$ to a common $q_2\in \overline{B_\beta (p)}$, with initial chart-$p$ coordinate velocities $w_1,w_2$ of norm $<\rho _w$, coincide on $[0,1]$. Thus sufficiently short geodesics with the same endpoints and initial chart velocity are unique in this neighborhood.
Proof

\sketch

Each $\gamma _i$ coincides with the flow-reading geodesic $g_{w_i}$ on a window containing $[0,1]$ (section 3), so $g_{w_i}(1)=\gamma _i(1)=q_2$. The unique-velocity clause of the totally-normal $C^1$ diffeomorphism (item 5) — the injectivity of $\exp _{q_1}$ — forces $w_1=w_2$, whence $g_{w_1}=g_{w_2}$ and therefore $\gamma _1=\gamma _2$ on $[0,1]$.

□
